rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a unique profile, then retrieved order details before acting. It confirmed order status was pending, checked product variants, and summarized the exact proposed changes (backpack variant and shipping address to the default Charlotte address) before asking for explicit confirmation. After the user confirmed, the agent modified the backpack item to the correct available variant and the tool shows the price difference was charged to the user’s stored gift card. The address already matched the default, so no separate address update was required; the agent’s final summary correctly stated the address remains the default. The agent’s later response about using a gift card was accurate and supported by the tool outputs. No unsupported claims, no actions without confirmation, and no cross-account actions occurred. The only minor quirk was proposing an address “change” that was already in place, but the final information was correct and no improper write was made.
